name: title-1
text: 今天给大家介绍我在二零二二年做的一项独立研究：一种用计算机生成住宅平面的方法。
text_en: Today I'd like to introduce an independent study I did in twenty twenty-two: a way of generating apartment floor plans by computer.
zh: 今天给大家介绍我在 2022 年做的一项独立研究：一种用计算机生成住宅平面的方法。
en: Today I'd like to introduce an independent study I did in 2022: a way of generating apartment floor plans by computer.

name: title-2
text: 核心算法，叫做波函数坍缩，英文缩写是 W F C。
text_en: The core algorithm is called wave function collapse, W F C for short.
zh: 核心算法，叫做波函数坍缩，英文缩写是 WFC。
en: The core algorithm is called wave function collapse — WFC for short.

name: algo-1
text: 这种算法，由马克西姆·古敏提出。它只依靠两样东西：随机，和相邻单元之间的局部约束。
text_en: The algorithm was proposed by Maxim Gumin. It relies on only two things: randomness, and local constraints between neighbouring cells.
zh: 这种算法，由马克西姆·古敏提出。它只依靠两样东西：随机，和相邻单元之间的局部约束。
en: The algorithm was proposed by Maxim Gumin. It relies on only two things: randomness, and local constraints between neighbouring cells.

name: algo-2
text: 所以它不依赖已有的经验，可以产生全新的设计。
text_en: So it does not depend on past experience, and can produce entirely new designs.
zh: 所以它不依赖已有的经验，可以产生全新的设计。
en: So it does not depend on past experience, and can produce entirely new designs.

name: algo-3
text: 从最基本的家具和人体工程的逻辑出发，自下而上，生成整个平面。
text_en: Starting from the basic logic of furniture and ergonomics, it generates the whole plan from the bottom up.
zh: 从最基本的家具和人体工程的逻辑出发，自下而上，生成整个平面。
en: Starting from the basic logic of furniture and ergonomics, it generates the whole plan from the bottom up.

name: grid-1
text: 波函数坍缩算法，不善于解决大、而且特定性强的网格。在我们的场合下，效率和细节，不可兼得。
text_en: Wave function collapse is not good at large grids with highly specific requirements. In our case, efficiency and detail cannot both be had.
zh: 波函数坍缩算法，不善于解决大、而且特定性强的网格。在我们的场合下，效率和细节，不可兼得。
en: Wave function collapse is not good at large grids with highly specific requirements. In our case, efficiency and detail cannot both be had.

parts.zh: 波函数坍缩算法，不善于解决大、而且特定性强的网格。
parts.en: Wave function collapse is not good at large grids with highly specific requirements.

parts.zh: 在我们的场合下，效率和细节，不可兼得。
parts.en: In our case, efficiency and detail cannot both be had.

name: grid-2
text: 网格选择在此，是相当关键的问题。我没有用常见的二十厘米或三十厘米网格，而是选了五十五厘米。
text_en: So the choice of grid is a crucial question here. Instead of the usual twenty or thirty centimetre grid, I chose fifty-five centimetres.
zh: 网格选择在此，是相当关键的问题。我没有用常见的 20 厘米或 30 厘米网格，而是选了 55 厘米。
en: So the choice of grid is a crucial question here. Instead of the usual 20 or 30 cm grid, I chose 55 cm.

parts.zh: 网格选择在此，是相当关键的问题。
parts.en: So the choice of grid is a crucial question here.

parts.zh: 我没有用常见的 20 厘米或 30 厘米网格，而是选了 55 厘米。
parts.en: Instead of the usual 20 or 30 cm grid, I chose 55 cm.

name: grid-3
text: 这是一个人站立时包含两臂的宽度，也接近衣柜的进深、最窄的过道，以及橱柜台面的深度。
text_en: That is the width of a standing person including both arms, and close to the depth of a wardrobe, the narrowest passage, and the depth of a kitchen counter.
zh: 这是一个人站立时包含两臂的宽度，也接近衣柜的进深、最窄的过道，以及橱柜台面的深度。
en: That is the width of a standing person including both arms — and close to the depth of a wardrobe, the narrowest passage, and the depth of a kitchen counter.

name: grid-4
text: 在这种网格下，墙的厚度四舍五入算作零个格子；而门，四舍五入变成两格宽。
text_en: On this grid, wall thickness rounds to zero cells, and a door rounds to two cells wide.
zh: 在这种网格下，墙的厚度四舍五入算作零个格子；而门，四舍五入变成两格宽。
en: On this grid, wall thickness rounds to zero cells, and a door rounds to two cells wide.

name: pixel-1
text: 我采用的方法，先要把平面图变成像素。
text_en: The method I use first turns the plan into pixels.
zh: 我采用的方法，先要把平面图变成像素。
en: The method I use first turns the plan into pixels.

name: pixel-2
text: 床、衣柜、过道、门、窗，每个格子得到一个编码，也就是一种颜色。
text_en: Bed, wardrobe, passage, door, window: every cell gets a code, which is to say a colour.
zh: 床、衣柜、过道、门、窗，每个格子得到一个编码，也就是一种颜色。
en: Bed, wardrobe, passage, door, window: every cell gets a code, which is to say a colour.

name: pixel-3
text: 任意相邻的四个格子，组成一块拼图：四个角，各带一种颜色。
text_en: Any four neighbouring cells form one tile: four corners, each carrying a colour.
zh: 任意相邻的四个格子，组成一块拼图：四个角，各带一种颜色。
en: Any four neighbouring cells form one tile: four corners, each carrying a colour.

name: library-1
text: 连接的可能性非常多，手工定义很容易出错。
text_en: The possible connections are vast, and defining them by hand is easily buggy.
zh: 连接的可能性非常多，手工定义很容易出错。
en: The possible connections are vast, and defining them by hand is easily buggy.

name: library-2
text: 所以，连接库是从样本里自动提取的。这可以看作一种机器学习。不过，样本库的完善度，会对生成产生局限。
text_en: So the library of connections is extracted automatically from samples. It can be seen as a kind of machine learning. However, the completeness of the sample library limits what can be generated.
zh: 所以，连接库是从样本里自动提取的。这可以看作一种机器学习。不过，样本库的完善度，会对生成产生局限。
en: So the library of connections is extracted automatically from samples. It can be seen as a kind of machine learning. However, the completeness of the sample library limits what can be generated.

parts.zh: 所以，连接库是从样本里自动提取的。这可以看作一种机器学习。
parts.en: So the library of connections is extracted automatically from samples. It can be seen as a kind of machine learning.

parts.zh: 不过，样本库的完善度，会对生成产生局限。
parts.en: However, the completeness of the sample library limits what can be generated.

name: library-3
text: 十九个卧室样本，给出一百七十九种拼接，以及每一种出现的频率。
text_en: Nineteen bedroom samples yield one hundred and seventy-nine connections, and how often each one occurs.
zh: 19 个卧室样本，给出 179 种拼接，以及每一种出现的频率。
en: Nineteen bedroom samples yield 179 connections, and how often each one occurs.

name: collapse-1
text: 一个房间的生成，从一扇门开始，因为一个房间总会有入口。在这个确定的位置上，就首先坍缩。
text_en: Generating a room starts from a door, because a room always has an entrance. That position is certain, so it collapses first.
zh: 一个房间的生成，从一扇门开始，因为一个房间总会有入口。在这个确定的位置上，就首先坍缩。
en: Generating a room starts from a door, because a room always has an entrance. That position is certain, so it collapses first.

parts.zh: 一个房间的生成，从一扇门开始，因为一个房间总会有入口。
parts.en: Generating a room starts from a door, because a room always has an entrance.

parts.zh: 在这个确定的位置上，就首先坍缩。
parts.en: That position is certain, so it collapses first.

name: collapse-entropy
text: 其他的位置，还处于叠加态，但是我们可以计算它们的熵。这里的熵，是一个信息论的概念：可能性越集中的位置，熵越低。
text_en: The other positions are still in superposition, but we can compute their entropy. Entropy here is a concept from information theory: the more concentrated the possibilities at a position, the lower its entropy.
zh: 其他的位置，还处于“叠加态”，但是我们可以计算它们的熵。这里的熵，是一个信息论的概念：可能性越集中的位置，熵越低。
en: The other positions are still in superposition, but we can compute their entropy. Entropy here is a concept from information theory: the more concentrated the possibilities at a position, the lower its entropy.

parts.zh: 其他的位置，还处于“叠加态”，但是我们可以计算它们的熵。
parts.en: The other positions are still in superposition, but we can compute their entropy.

parts.zh: 这里的熵，是一个信息论的概念：可能性越集中的位置，熵越低。
parts.en: Entropy here is a concept from information theory: the more concentrated the possibilities at a position, the lower its entropy.

name: collapse-2
text: 每一步，计算所有待定位置的熵，让熵最低的那一个，坍缩成一块合法的拼图。如果有若干位置的熵相等，就让其中一个随机的位置坍缩。
text_en: At each step the entropy of every open position is computed, and the one with the lowest entropy collapses into a valid tile. If several positions tie, one of them is chosen at random.
zh: 每一步，计算所有待定位置的熵，让熵最低的那一个，坍缩成一块合法的拼图。如果有若干位置的熵相等，就让其中一个随机的位置坍缩。
en: At each step the entropy of every open position is computed, and the one with the lowest entropy collapses into a valid tile. If several positions tie, one of them is chosen at random.

parts.zh: 每一步，计算所有待定位置的熵，让熵最低的那一个，坍缩成一块合法的拼图。
parts.en: At each step the entropy of every open position is computed, and the one with the lowest entropy collapses into a valid tile.

parts.zh: 如果有若干位置的熵相等，就让其中一个随机的位置坍缩。
parts.en: If several positions tie, one of them is chosen at random.

name: collapse-3
text: 走进无解的死路，就推倒再来。
text_en: A dead end with no solution means starting over.
zh: 走进无解的死路，就推倒再来。
en: A dead end with no solution means starting over.

name: collapse-4
text: 绝大多数尝试会失败。只有较小的几率，一个房间闭合了。
text_en: Most attempts fail. Only with a small probability does a room close.
zh: 绝大多数尝试会失败。只有较小的几率，一个房间闭合了。
en: Most attempts fail. Only with a small probability does a room close.

name: fitness-1
text: 闭合的房间，接着要打分。评分是几个方面的加权。
text_en: A closed room is then scored. The score is a weighted sum of several aspects.
zh: 闭合的房间，接着要打分。评分是几个方面的加权。
en: A closed room is then scored. The score is a weighted sum of several aspects.

name: fitness-2
text: 其一，周长与面积之比，越小越好。这引导房间尽量方正，但是这不是唯一的标准。
text_en: First, the ratio of perimeter to area: the smaller the better. This steers a room towards a compact, square shape, but it is not the only criterion.
zh: 其一，周长与面积之比，越小越好。这引导房间尽量方正，但是这不是唯一的标准。
en: First, the ratio of perimeter to area: the smaller the better. This steers a room towards a compact, square shape — but it is not the only criterion.

parts.zh: 其一，周长与面积之比，越小越好。
parts.en: First, the ratio of perimeter to area: the smaller the better.

parts.zh: 这引导房间尽量方正，但是这不是唯一的标准。
parts.en: This steers a room towards a compact, square shape — but it is not the only criterion.

name: fitness-3
text: 其二，面积合理。面积的分数先升后降：超过合适的大小，分数就回落。高档住宅的空间比较宽松，回落得慢一些。
text_en: Second, a reasonable area. The area score rises, then falls: past a suitable size it drops again. Upscale housing is more generous with space, so its score drops more slowly.
zh: 其二，面积合理。面积的分数先升后降：超过合适的大小，分数就回落。高档住宅的空间比较宽松，回落得慢一些。
en: Second, a reasonable area. The area score rises, then falls: past a suitable size it drops again. Upscale housing is more generous with space, so its score drops more slowly.

parts.zh: 其二，面积合理。面积的分数先升后降：超过合适的大小，分数就回落。
parts.en: Second, a reasonable area. The area score rises, then falls: past a suitable size it drops again.

parts.zh: 高档住宅的空间比较宽松，回落得慢一些。
parts.en: Upscale housing is more generous with space, so its score drops more slowly.

name: fitness-4
text: 其三，储物空间，这是越多越好，但边际收益递减。
text_en: Third, storage: the more the better, with diminishing returns.
zh: 其三，储物空间，这是越多越好，但边际收益递减。
en: Third, storage: the more the better, with diminishing returns.

name: whole-1
text: 卧室、卫生间、厨房、客厅，各自生成，各自评分。客厅会是整个户型的枢纽。
text_en: Bedroom, bathroom, kitchen, living room: each is generated and scored on its own. The living room becomes the hub of the whole apartment.
zh: 卧室、卫生间、厨房、客厅，各自生成，各自评分。客厅会是整个户型的枢纽。
en: Bedroom, bathroom, kitchen, living room: each is generated and scored on its own. The living room becomes the hub of the whole apartment.

parts.zh: 卧室、卫生间、厨房、客厅，各自生成，各自评分。
parts.en: Bedroom, bathroom, kitchen, living room: each is generated and scored on its own.

parts.zh: 客厅会是整个户型的枢纽。
parts.en: The living room becomes the hub of the whole apartment.

name: whole-2
text: 高分的房间被留下，接到客厅预留的开口上，拼成一套完整的住宅。全套住宅的评分，是各个房间得分，和体形系数的加权。
text_en: The high-scoring rooms are kept and attached to the openings reserved in the living room, forming a complete apartment. Its score is a weighted sum of the rooms' scores and its shape factor.
zh: 高分的房间被留下，接到客厅预留的开口上，拼成一套完整的住宅。全套住宅的评分，是各个房间得分，和体形系数的加权。
en: The high-scoring rooms are kept and attached to the openings reserved in the living room, forming a complete apartment. Its score is a weighted sum of the rooms' scores and its shape factor.

parts.zh: 高分的房间被留下，接到客厅预留的开口上，拼成一套完整的住宅。
parts.en: The high-scoring rooms are kept and attached to the openings reserved in the living room, forming a complete apartment.

parts.zh: 全套住宅的评分，是各个房间得分，和体形系数的加权。
parts.en: Its score is a weighted sum of the rooms' scores and its shape factor.

name: whole-3
text: 这是当年分数最高的几个结果。
text_en: These are some of the highest-scoring results from back then.
zh: 这是当年分数最高的几个结果。
en: These are some of the highest-scoring results from back then.

name: model-1
text: 把平面组件进行三维建模，就会产生三维预览图。以现在的工具，非常容易。
text_en: Model the plan's components in three dimensions and you get a three-dimensional preview. With today's tools, that is very easy.
zh: 把平面组件进行三维建模，就会产生三维预览图。以现在的工具，非常容易。
en: Model the plan's components in three dimensions and you get a 3D preview. With today's tools, that is very easy.

name: model-2
text: 作为一个试验，它初步实现了生成的能力。
text_en: As an experiment, it has achieved a first working ability to generate.
zh: 作为一个试验，它初步实现了生成的能力。
en: As an experiment, it has achieved a first working ability to generate.

name: studio-1
text: 当年，这些步骤分散在几个脚本里，评分的系数要到代码里去改。
text_en: Back then these steps were spread over several scripts, and the scoring coefficients had to be changed inside the code.
zh: 当年，这些步骤分散在几个脚本里，评分的系数要到代码里去改。
en: Back then these steps were spread over several scripts, and the scoring coefficients had to be changed inside the code.

name: studio-2
text: 现在，前端开发成本很低，我把它们收进一个网页：画样本，看拼图库，改参数，生成房间，组合户型，都在同一个界面里完成。对它继续调试的直观性和效率，可以大大提高。
text_en: Today front-end development is cheap, so I gathered them into a single web page: draw samples, inspect the tile library, set parameters, generate rooms, combine apartments, all in one interface. Tuning it further becomes far more intuitive and efficient.
zh: 现在，前端开发成本很低，我把它们收进一个网页：画样本，看拼图库，改参数，生成房间，组合户型，都在同一个界面里完成。对它继续调试的直观性和效率，可以大大提高。
en: Today front-end development is cheap, so I gathered them into a single web page: draw samples, inspect the tile library, set parameters, generate rooms, combine apartments — all in one interface. Tuning it further becomes far more intuitive and efficient.

parts.zh: 现在，前端开发成本很低，我把它们收进一个网页：
parts.en: Today front-end development is cheap, so I gathered them into a single web page:

parts.zh: 画样本，看拼图库，改参数，生成房间，组合户型，都在同一个界面里完成。
parts.en: draw samples, inspect the tile library, set parameters, generate rooms, combine apartments — all in one interface.

parts.zh: 对它继续调试的直观性和效率，可以大大提高。
parts.en: Tuning it further becomes far more intuitive and efficient.

name: ending-1
text: 当年我睡在书房里，看着白板，苦心孤诣，花了两个月的业余时间搞这个。
text_en: Back then I slept in my study, staring at the whiteboard, and spent two months of spare time working this out.
zh: 当年我睡在书房里，看着白板，苦心孤诣，花了两个月的业余时间搞这个。
en: Back then I slept in my study, staring at the whiteboard, and spent two months of spare time working this out.

name: ending-2
text: 而且，我一直知道，这里面有过多可以改进的技术。
text_en: And I have always known that a great deal in it could be improved technically.
zh: 而且，我一直知道，这里面有过多可以改进的技术。
en: And I have always known that a great deal in it could be improved technically.

name: ending-3
text: 不过，我认为这个方法对于户型的理解非常本质，希望它能帮助有兴趣的同学们，增进对这类问题的理解。在这个层面上，它还是具有一些潜力。
text_en: Still, I think this method gets at something essential about apartment layouts. I hope it helps interested students understand this kind of problem better. At that level, it still has some potential.
zh: 不过，我认为这个方法对于户型的理解非常本质，希望它能帮助有兴趣的同学们，增进对这类问题的理解。在这个层面上，它还是具有一些潜力。
en: Still, I think this method gets at something essential about apartment layouts. I hope it helps interested students understand this kind of problem better. At that level, it still has some potential.

parts.zh: 不过，我认为这个方法对于户型的理解非常本质，
parts.en: Still, I think this method gets at something essential about apartment layouts.

parts.zh: 希望它能帮助有兴趣的同学们，增进对这类问题的理解。
parts.en: I hope it helps interested students understand this kind of problem better.

parts.zh: 在这个层面上，它还是具有一些潜力。
parts.en: At that level, it still has some potential.
